proposed_new_terms.definition: A Map<string, ReadFileEntry> maintained in ToolUseContext that records every file the model has read, along with content, modification timestamp, offset, and limit; used to enforce the read-before-write contract and read deduplication.
The invariant enforced by Write, Edit, and NotebookEdit tools that the model must have read a file before modifying it, preventing blind overwrites and silent data loss.
A content-hash-keyed backup created before file edits, stored at ~/.claude/file-history/{sessionId}/{sha256-hash}@v{N}, providing checkpoint-restore semantics for undo operations.
